title: Review your collection and order
description: Enter the matching delivery and payment details. This front-end mock never submits a real order.
secureBadge: Data lasts for this checkout only
recipientDescription: The name and phone number are used only for this mock delivery and are not saved.
memberPrefillHint: You can edit the copied values without changing your member profile.
deliveryDescription: The required fields match the delivery method selected in your cart.
editDelivery: Return to cart to change delivery
pickupDescription: No address or store is required. Use a social link after completion to discuss a mock pickup.
paymentDescription: Choose a bank transfer or validate the format of credit card fields.
bankNote: This page does not create real transfer instructions or contact a bank.
cardholderPlaceholder: Enter the name shown on the card
securityHint: The card number, expiry, and security code stay only in this page's memory and are cleared after submission.
summaryDescription: Every amount reflects the current cart state.
mockNotice: No charge or real delivery is created, and recipient and card forms are never persisted.
storageError: The cart could not be cleared, so no order was created. Check browser storage and try again.
emptyCartError: Your cart is already empty. Add an item before checking out again.

errors.storeInvalid: That store does not match the selected delivery provider.
errors.expiry: Enter a valid month and four-digit year.
errors.expiryExpired: This card expiry date has passed.

completeDescription: The order was created for this session and your cart was cleared. This is not a real transaction.
socialDescription: Follow the official channels for more breeding notes and the latest updates.
completeMockNotice: Refreshing or leaving this page immediately invalidates this completion state.
completeVisualAlt: Recording of Beetles order completion artwork
